chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, who said:

I asked Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about the man who copulates with the woman near the private part but they do not discharge, 'When is the ritual bath (Ghusl) obligatory?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When the two circumcised parts meet, the ritual bath becomes obligatory.' I said, 'The meeting of the two circumcised parts is the emergence of the glans?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.

key_terms.الْخِتَانَانِ: The two circumcised parts (glans and entrance)

ai.seo_question: When does Ghusl become obligatory if ejaculation does not occur during intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential threshold for Ghusl al-Janabah by defining 'meeting of the circumcised parts' (iltiqa' al-khitani) as the point of full penetration of the glans, even without ejaculation. This ruling is pivotal in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between minor impurity (ghusl) and major impurity, emphasizing physical contact over seminal emission. It reflects the Imams' precise legal methodology in addressing practical marital scenarios with clarity and ease.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ismail who said,

‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who copulates with a woman nearby the private part but they both do not discharge, ‘When is the washing Obligated?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the two circumcised parts meet, so the washing is Obligated’. So I said, ‘The meeting of the two circumcised part, it is the tip of the manhood?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il who has said the following: “

I once asked al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs sexual relation with woman near her vagina but does not discharge, if Ghusl (bath) becomes necessary. He (the Imam) said, ‘When private parts touch each other Ghusl (bath) becomes necessary.’ I (the narrator) then asked, ‘Is touching of private parts disappearance of glans penis?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Yes, it is such.’”
